result:
I’d make empathy unavoidable.

Not mind-reading, and not forced agreement—just the inability to look away from another person’s suffering or joy as if it didn’t matter. If every person, even briefly, truly felt the weight of what their indifference, cruelty, or neglect does to someone else, I think many of the world’s worst systems would collapse under the pressure of simple human recognition.
